notes.title: Stellar Feedback and Suggestions for Future Builds
notes.content:
Thank you Steam community for your genuine and helpful feedback!

Here we have a very experimental short piece which we had no idea how it would do, the overall positive reception and constructive criticism is a pleasure! Thank you so much :)

I would like to reveal that this is but a small step towards future builds and titles which will be far greater and deeper. In addition to a very fun "normal" VR game with some very fun and unique gameplay in alpha stages. Stay tuned!

In the meantime please feel free to share any suggestions or VR theories and concerns as we develop our upcoming interdimensional puzzle adventure game.

We are experimenting with a full 360 free movement system to navigate through unique 4D spaces in a completely new way through VR. We are modeling our puzzles, experiences, conflicts and triumphs based on ancient myths to give you an idea of where we are starting from.

Again, thank you so much for your feedback and support!

- Matthew Reed

notes.title: Big Thank You to Steam and Community!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I wanted to thank Steam and the amazing community of gamers for hosting my experimental VR short!

I hope to bring you something unlike anything you've experienced before in VR. Be careful of ghosts hidden in the machine ;)

More to come!
